# Heddlemere assets

[한국어](ASSETS-KO.md)

Every graphic, font, 3D model, sound effect and piece of music in Heddlemere is
**generated by code in this repository at build time**. No images, fonts, recordings
or scores are taken from anywhere else, and no CC0 assets are used. All assets below
are original work under the same copyright and licence as the source:
**Apache-2.0** (Copyright 2026 devgyurak, the cleancart.nds maintainer).

The generator is `tools/mkassets.py`; the code that draws, synthesises and lays out
lives in `tools/cvtools/` (shared with the other games, plus `hmart.py` of its own). The same source always produces the same bytes.

The PNG files in `docs/images/` (if any) are README screenshots captured from the
built ROM. They are documentation, not assets: the build never reads them and they
are not in the ROM.

| File (output) | Contents | Generator | Source / licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cv_font_tiles` | 5x7 pixel font (ASCII 0x20–0x5F), 4bpp | `cvtools/font.py` `GLYPHS` (glyphs drawn as strings) | original, Apache-2.0 |
| `cv_ui_tiles`, `cv_ui_pal` | window frame and gauge tiles | `images.ui_tiles()` | original, Apache-2.0 |
| `cv_smp_*`, `cv_sound_bank`, `cv_sample_names` | the samples the engine links (`SAMPLES_USED` in `cvtools/audio.py`) | `cvtools/audio.py` `make_samples()` | original, Apache-2.0 |
| `cv_song_*`, `cv_song_names` | the song `selvage` (steady dorian piece at 88 bpm, no drums), composed by code; played on the title and in the credits | `cvtools/audio.py` `SONGS`, `compose()` | original, Apache-2.0 |
| `cv_title_tiles`, `cv_title_map`, `cv_title_pal` | the title lettering "HEDDLEMERE": 30 x 4 tiles (4bpp), a dark outline and six thread colours, plus a blank and a solid panel tile; one 16-colour palette line (BG palette line 8). the name woven in six thread colours with a darker 2x2 checker (weft over and under the warp), a dark outline and a dark strip behind it; the title scene lays it over a cloth drawn by `gfx/loom.c` | `cvtools/hmart.py` `title_lettering()` | original, Apache-2.0 |
| `cv_orders` | the 40 loom orders (target colour, weave and dye per row, budget, passes, slack) and their par, packed by `tools/hmorder/pack.py` | `tools/order_check.py` reading `tools/orders/ch*.txt` (authored text, checked by a search) | original, Apache-2.0 |
| `hm_col_*`, `hm_chapter_name`, `hm_active_cols`, `hm_program_ticks`, `hm_dye_line` | column, value and chapter names, the columns each chapter turns, the GX cycle cost of the four heddle programs (GBATEK figures), the dye lines | `tools/mkassets.py` from `tools/hmorder/model.py` | original, Apache-2.0 |
| `probe.bin` (NitroFS) | 2 KB known-CRC file the cart check reads | `tools/mkassets.py` | original, Apache-2.0 |
| banner icon (`icon.bmp`) | 32x32 4bpp icon, a framed square of woven cloth: four weft colours over a dark warp | `tools/mkassets.py` `heddlemere_icon()` | original, Apache-2.0 |
